conflict.title: Needs resolution
conflict.description: Open integration options and check the list binding. Inspect conflicts and uncertain writes with lists_assistant.get_sync_issues, then use lists_assistant.resolve_sync_conflict or lists_assistant.resolve_sync_write. For a storage error, preserve the data file and check logs before restoring a backup.

get_lists.name: Read lists and products
get_lists.description: Return all accessible active lists and products for this account, including their IDs and metadata.

create_list.name: Create a list
create_list.description: Create a cloud list. Returns list_id when a response is requested. Select it in integration options to add its todo entity.

rename_list.name: Rename a list
rename_list.description: Rename the list with the specified numeric ID.

delete_list.name: Deactivate a list
delete_list.description: Deactivate the list using Active:0. Its todo entity becomes unavailable. This is not a confirmed permanent deletion.

add_item.name: Add a product
add_item.description: Add a product with optional metadata. Returns item_id when a response is requested.

update_item.name: Update a product
update_item.description: Change only the supplied fields. Empty amount, unit or description clears that field. Price 0 sets the price to zero.

delete_item.name: Delete a product
delete_item.description: Delete the product with the specified numeric ID from this list.
